manuscript-cream.$description: Manuscript Cream — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark — warm off-white that reads as paper rather than screen

press-black.$description: Press Black — All borders, body text, headings, icon strokes — the single ink that draws the entire structural system

sage-border.$description: Sage Border — Secondary card and button borders where a softer hairline is needed — desaturated green-gray

mist-green.$description: Mist Green — Icon strokes and fills, button borders on tertiary controls — barely-there gray-green for subordinate elements

paper-shadow.$description: Paper Shadow — Button fill for neutral or disabled states — warm gray-green, almost a shadow of the cream canvas

smoke.$description: Smoke — The only shadow tone used — rgba(0,0,0,0.2) modulated to a neutral mid-gray for the single soft button shadow

highlighter-lime.$description: Highlighter Lime — Primary accent fill on cards, tags, and featured swatches — electric yellow-green that reads as a marker pen swiped across the page

cornflower-wash.$description: Cornflower Wash — Secondary accent fill on cards, category chips, and illustration swatches — dusty cornflower blue that cools the palette without darkening it

spring-green.$description: Spring Green — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

abcarizonasans.$description: Body, UI controls, navigation, captions, links, footer — the workhorse grotesque for everything that isn't a heading

abcarizonaflare.$description: Section and card headings — flared terminals and light weights create editorial authority; weight 300 at 57px is a deliberate whisper that trusts the reader to lean in

abccameraheavy.$description: Hero and display headings — extremely tight leading (0.74) stacks letters into dense editorial blocks; this is the loudest voice on the page and is used sparingly

abcarizonamixvariable.$description: Subheadings and inline labels — sits between body and section heading, bridging the grotesque to the display faces

abcarizonasansvariable.$description: ABCArizonaSansVariable — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

abcarizonatext.$description: ABCArizonaText — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

abcarizonamix.$description: ABCArizonaMix — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
